falsifiable_implication: A future shared-assigned versus assigned-I4 gap attributed to native backbone sharing alone should persist when projector ownership is held at private maps. Loss or reversal under shared-native/private-A undermines that account. Persistence is conditional native-package evidence, not a universal isolated backbone effect.

later_control.name: Same shared native assigned recipe with four independent A_m
later_control.hold_fixed: Existing assigned K_m/Q_m/E, native architecture/shared and private parameters, own CE, total scalar-loss weights, initial native bytes, streams, optimizer rules, schedule, selectors and native probability pool.
later_control.one_change: Replace common A by one independently trained bare A_m per route, each initialized as an exact copy of the current A_0. Gradients follow the unchanged scalar objective; no special scaling or protection.
later_control.cost_boundary: Four query projections remain; parameter update/storage and measured complete acquisition cost increase. No serving projector or additional native serving computation.
later_control.identification: Within shared native architecture, tests projector ownership/capacity package. Against existing assigned I4/private A, holds projection ownership fixed but still changes native capacity/optimization/selection package.
later_control.not_identified: Pure projector geometry at equal trainable parameter count; general interaction between native and projector sharing; isolated backbone causal effect.
later_control.arithmetic_decomposition: Y(S,S)−Y(I,I)=[Y(S,S)−Y(S,I)]+[Y(S,I)−Y(I,I)] for consistently evaluated scalar metric Y; an observed path identity, not a completed factorial causal study.
